criteria.requirement: Implement feedgen.upsert.upsert_entries(feed,entries) and frozen UpsertResult(added,updated). Use actual FeedGenerator/FeedEntry APIs. Validate all existing/incoming entries have unique nonempty string IDs before mutation; invalid late input or generator failure preserves original entries. Replace matching IDs at their original position with supplied entry objects, append new IDs in incoming order, retain unrelated exact entry objects and metadata/extensions. Do not merge entries by title or destructively edit old entry fields. Empty input is valid; duplicate old IDs are explicit errors.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
